svg.text: Smithmagic is the forge inside Dofus. Rune stones cut like gems, molten glyphs, Ba / Pa / Ra tiers — our forge signature in the game's own craft.
Four elemental runes (Ba, Pa, Ra sizes)
orbit the Dofus on the anvil: the
whole build-crafting loop in one mark.
The DF rune — shared stem, angular D,
Fehu-like F arms — glows molten inside
a cut rune stone with ◆ rivets.
A gold-banded hammer lands on a
molten rune: the moment of smithmagic.
One cut, one glyph per characteristic, coloured by DESIGN.md stat/element tokens — for stat rows, filters, smithmagic UI.
Ba · Pa · Ra = small · medium · large. Use as rarity / membership ladder
